?

Express 12x+12(x−3)(x−1)(x+5) as a sum of partial fractions.

a
 3(x−3)−2(x−1)−1(x+5)
b
 4(x−3)+2(x−1)−1(x+5)
c

d

e
 3(x−3)+4(x−1)−1(x+5)
